system.description:
When you are touching a prop that has both a natural tag and a terrain tag, you get +1 on all checks except defense checks. [CR11] Modifications to the judgment are invalid.

A cloak imbued with the blessings of a tree spirit. When you wear this, plants and wind will bestow upon you a little help.

Young green sprouts [core material] (30G) + cloak (60G) + Aoi amulet (60G) + [Magic catalyst 2] (20G) x 3 + Crafting Cost (100G)
